info.title: Clinic API
info.description: Existing backend/API contracts. Import this generated file into Apidog. Cookie sessions, same-origin CSRF writes, current account/clinic/patient authorization. No public registration, fake verification, bearer tokens or production readiness claim. JSON Schema cannot encode all permission, financial, temporal or cross-field rules: consult each operation and repository API guides.

servers.description: Local fictional-data API only; APP_ORIGIN normally http://localhost:4173.

get.summary: Create or retrieve anonymous CSRF session
get.description:
Cookie session, never bearer authentication. Manager authority is independent of login method. Restricted setup/recovery sessions do not authorize clinic data. Password changes revoke sessions; use a new session/CSRF handshake afterwards.

No authenticated account required. Keeps clinic.sid cookie. Extract csrfToken for subsequent writes.
